audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3, First item and 2+ items are marked Dr. Mundo in the full layer but carried Akshan-favoured boilerplate whys ("trades start at angles melee kits literally cannot answer", "take over the lane and start roaming").
audit.why: The lane really does flip once Heart Zapper is running, and again at Maximum Dosage — the content layer says so. The full layer's stage text was never reconciled with its own side fields.
audit.corrected: Those three stages now give the Mundo-side reason: the W's damage-banking, Executioner's Calling being required before Youmuu's can kill, and current-health cleaver plus R sustain outliving lethality entirely.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike said Maximum Dosage "gives a huge heal-over-time plus move speed and bonus damage".
audit.why: Riot's description is "instantly healing a percent of his missing Health", then move speed and regeneration over a long duration — the big number is instant, not over time, and there is no bonus damage on it (the bonus AD lives on Blunt Force Trauma's passive). The instant part is exactly what breaks Comeuppance, which scales on missing health.
audit.corrected: The spike now states the instant missing-health heal and ties it to why your R's missing-HP scaling evaporates while you are still storing bullets.

audit.whatIsWrong: Infected Bonesaw is called a "percent-max-HP cleaver" in three strings, and Heart Zapper's actual mechanic never appears anywhere — it was described only as a vague "burst + sustain window".
audit.why: Riot's description says the bonesaw deals damage "based on their current health", not max health. That inverts the advice: it hits hardest when you are healthy and least when you are low. Heart Zapper (W, 17/16.5/16/15.5/15s) "stor[es] a portion of damage he takes" and heals him a percentage of it on the burst — so poking Mundo during W converts your chip directly into his health. That is the single decisive interaction of the matchup and it was missing.
audit.corrected: Cleaver scaling corrected to current health, and Heart Zapper's store-and-heal is now stated with its 17s cooldown across the cooldown breakdown, the do's, the don'ts, the interactions report and whys[2].

edits.after: Chip him off the wave, but never into Heart Zapper — it banks your damage as his heal. Poke in its 17s downtime, then leave.

edits.before: His percent-HP cleaver poke plus passive regen out-sustain your chip — you can't convert poke on a target who heals it back between trades.

edits.before: This is where the lane tilts toward him. You out-poke a pre-6 Mundo with Q and the passive double-shot, but once his W toggle and passive HP regen are running your chip stops sticking — and the moment he hits 6, R Maximum Dosage heals a huge chunk over its duration while buffing his move speed and damage, erasing your whole poke phase. Save your E Heroic Swing as an escape, not a commit; you cannot all-in a Mundo who out-heals your full Q-passive-R combo. Farm, trade only when his cleaver is down, and accept that R turns him from chip-able to immovable.
edits.after: This is where the lane tilts toward him. You out-poke a pre-6 Mundo with Q and the passive double-shot, but once Heart Zapper is running your chip stops sticking — the W banks a portion of the damage he takes and heals him off its burst, so poking into it pays him. It is 17s at rank 1: trade in that downtime, never during. The moment he hits 6, R Maximum Dosage instantly heals a percent of his missing health and keeps regenerating, erasing your whole poke phase. Save your E Heroic Swing as an escape, not a commit; you cannot all-in a Mundo who out-heals your full Q-passive-R combo.

edits.before: Long game is his, full stop — but he has no gap-closer, so he doesn't kill you either, which is exactly why this stays even. His percent-max-HP cleaver and R sustain make him unkillable to lethality, so stop trying to out-DPS him. Your job is to leave: W camo roams and the 0.5s E cooldown reset on takedowns let you make plays mid and bot where your R Comeuppance actually closes a squishy. Build an Executioner's Calling so your damage bites through his regen, and win the map while he's stuck farming a side lane he can never lose.
edits.after: Long game is his, full stop — but he has no gap-closer, so he doesn't kill you either, which is exactly why this stays even. Build an Executioner's Calling so your damage bites through his regen and the Heart Zapper heal, and win the map while he's stuck farming a side lane he can never lose.

notes: The _missing file listed 'Dr. Mundo bypasses stacking resistances (Maximum Dosage)' — that rule misfired. Maximum Dosage is a heal with no resistance interaction, so nothing was written from it. It also listed an auto-reset burst tell on Blunt Force Trauma; Riot's description is a targeted bag slam with no attack reset in the text, so that was not asserted either. The content layer's Serpent's Fang note (Mundo has no shield, so it does nothing) checks out against the kit and was left as-is.
